facts: Thirty percent of all Dalmatians are deaf in one or both ears. Because bulldogs have extremely short muzzles, many spend their lives fighting suffocation. Because Chihuahuas have such small skulls, the flow of spinal fluid can be restricted, causing hydrocephalus, a swelling of the brain.
The French Bulldog is incapable of reproducing naturally.
Dogs sometimes appear to smile -- much like humans -- with open mouth grinning. This may indicate a relaxed, submissive state.
Dogs curl up to keep themselves warm and protect vital organs.
The average dog's mouth can produce about 100-200 pounds of pressure per square inch.
